Ham Macaroni Breakfast Set.note: Default parts: wheat macaroni, pork ham, scrambled egg, buttered toast (wheat, butter), hot milk tea (evaporated milk). Pork ham = not halal.

Chicken Macaroni Breakfast Set.note: Wheat macaroni, chicken, egg, toast with butter, milk tea. No pork, lard or alcohol: halal from ingredients at a 'none' branch.

Luncheon Meat Noodle Breakfast Set.note: Wheat instant noodles; soy-seasoned broth = soy (+gluten); pork luncheon meat; egg; butter toast and milk tea = milk.

Scrambled Egg Toast Set.note: Egg, wheat toast, butter, evaporated milk. Vegetarian, not vegan.

Pineapple Bun with Butter.note: Lard crust = not vegetarian, not halal. Bun has wheat, egg, milk; butter = milk. Locals call it 菠萝油 (no Chinese name on the menu).

Pineapple Bun.note: Same bun and lard crust, no butter slab. Not vegetarian, not halal.

HK French Toast.note: Hidden peanuts (peanut butter filling). Egg batter, wheat bread, butter. Vegetable oil: vegetarian, halal. Locals say 西多士.

Scrambled Egg Sandwich.note: Wheat bread, egg, evaporated milk, butter.

Egg Tart.note: Butter pastry (no lard): vegetarian, halal from ingredients.

Ham Macaroni Soup.note: Wheat macaroni; pork ham = not halal; chicken broth. No egg by default (fried egg is an add-on).

Luncheon Meat Egg Instant Noodles.note: Wheat noodles, soy-seasoned broth, pork luncheon meat, fried egg. Locals call it 餐蛋面.

Satay Beef Instant Noodles.note: Satay sauce: peanuts, dried shrimp = crustaceans; mild = 1. Beef, no pork or alcohol: halal from ingredients. Sold out in extra.json.

Baked Pork Chop Rice.note: Soy sauce = soy + gluten; Worcestershire = fish + gluten (rule i); egg fried rice = egg; mozzarella = milk. Pork = not halal.

Baked Chicken Chop Rice.note: Soy sauce = soy + gluten; egg fried rice; milk, butter, cheese. Chicken, no pork or alcohol: halal from ingredients.

Sweet and Sour Pork Rice.note: Wheat and egg batter. Pork = not halal. No chilli.

Curry Chicken Rice.note: Coconut milk is not milk; no wheat, soy or dairy named. Mild = 1. Halal from ingredients.

Yangzhou Fried Rice.note: Prawns = crustaceans; egg; light soy = soy + gluten; pork char siu = not halal.

Curry Fish Balls.note: Fish paste = fish; wheat starch = gluten (stated). Spicy = 2. Coconut milk is not milk.

Borscht.note: Celery; beef = not vegetarian; halal from ingredients. Locals say 罗宋汤 (no Chinese name on the menu).

Fried Chicken Wings.note: Soy sauce = soy + gluten; fish sauce = fish. Halal from ingredients.

Baked Pork Chop Rice Set.note: Union of defaults: pork chop rice (soy, gluten, fish, egg, milk), borscht (celery), hot milk tea (milk). Not halal.

Curry Chicken Rice Set.note: Curry chicken rice (no allergens) + default hot milk tea (evaporated milk) = milk. Mild = 1.

Sweet and Sour Pork Rice Set.note: Union: battered pork (gluten, egg), borscht (celery), milk tea (milk). Not halal.

HK Milk Tea.note: Evaporated milk. Locals say 丝袜奶茶.

HK Coffee.note: Evaporated milk. No butter roast stated.

Horlicks.note: Malted barley and wheat = gluten; milk powder = milk.

Ovaltine.note: Barley malt = gluten; milk powder = milk.
